Origin Mode (DECOM) - relative vs absolute cursor addressing.
Auto Wrap Mode (DECAWM) - cursor moves to next line at right margin.
Application Cursor Keys (DECCKM) - arrow key escape sequence mode.
Bracketed Paste Mode (DECBPM) - wraps pasted text with markers.
Insert Mode (IRM) - inserted characters shift existing content.
Mouse Tracking Mode (DECXM) - basic mouse button reporting.
Mouse Motion Tracking (DECMM) - report mouse movement with button pressed.
Mouse All Tracking (DECMAM) - report all mouse movements.
SGR Mouse Encoding (DECSGR) - use SGR escape sequences for mouse.
Focus In/Out Events (DECFE) - send escape sequences on window focus.
Application Keypad Mode (DECNKM) - numeric keypad sends application codes.
Cursor Visibility - whether the cursor is rendered.
Reverse Video Mode - swap foreground and background colors.
Win32 Input Mode (XTerm 9001) - encode keyboard input as Win32 KEY_EVENT_RECORD.
Packed cursor state — row (12 bits) + col (12 bits) + visible (1 bit) + kbFlags (5 bits).

briefdescription.para: Fired to route user input bytes (keyboard, mouse) to the PTY — args: const char*, int.

detaileddescription.para: Args: const uint8_t* data, int length, int cursorRow, int cursorCol. Processor handler calls Skit::processOSC1337() then Video::advanceCursorForImage().

briefdescription.para: Fired by Video::applyDCSPayload() when a DCS sequence terminates.

detaileddescription.para: Processor handler calls Skit::processDCS() then Video::advanceCursorForImage(). Args: const uint8_t* data, int length. Fired synchronously on the READER THREAD.

briefdescription.para: Fired by Video::applyAPCPayload() when an APC sequence terminates.

detaileddescription.para: Processor handler calls Skit::processAPC(), forwards any Kitty response via writeToHost, then calls Video::advanceCursorForImage(). Args: const uint8_t* data, int length. Fired synchronously on the READER THREAD.

briefdescription.para: DST trigger key — lossless reflow, buffer reallocation, video + state sync.

detaileddescription.para: Args: cell (targetCols), cell (targetRows). Fired from Display::resized() via TextEditor's DST on the MESSAGE THREAD.

briefdescription.para: Fired on the reader thread for each chunk of PTY output data — args: const char*, int.

briefdescription.para: Fired on the reader thread for each data chunk for IPC byte broadcast — args: const char*, int.

briefdescription.para: Terminal identifier constants for ValueTree property names.

detaileddescription.para: This namespace contains static juce::Identifier constants used as keys when reading and writing terminal state to ValueTree objects. Using static Identifiers avoids string allocation on every property access.
